itinerary: Day 1 — Delhi to Haridwar: Delhi nunchi Haridwar ki journey start chestham. Har Ki Pauri visit chesi evening Ganga Aarti chustham. Tarvatha hotel check-in, dinner and night stay.
Day 2 — Haridwar to Lakhamandal: Breakfast tarvatha Lakhamandal ki travel chestham. Shiva Temple visit chesi hotel check-in avutham. Dinner tarvatha rest.
Day 3 — Yamunotri: Janki Chatti ki velli, akkadi nunchi Yamunotri darshan kosam trek chestham. Darshan tarvatha return avutham. Pony/doli charges extra.
Day 4 — Lakhamandal to Uttarkashi: Uttarkashi ki travel chesi Kashi Vishwanath Temple visit chestham. Tarvatha hotel check-in, dinner and night stay.
Day 5 — Gangotri: Uttarkashi nunchi Gangotri ki velli darshan cheskoni, malli Uttarkashi ki return avutham. Dinner and night stay hotel lo.
Day 6 — Uttarkashi to Sonprayag/Sitapur: Sonprayag leda Sitapur ki travel chestham. Hotel check-in ayyaka dinner chesi Kedarnath trek kosam rest teesukuntam.
Day 7 — Kedarnath: Early morning Kedarnath trek start chestham. Darshan tarvatha On A Trip camp lo night stay. Trek around 22 km; camp lo common washrooms untayi.
Day 8 — Kedarnath to Sonprayag/Sitapur: Trek back chesi Sonprayag/Sitapur ki return avutham. Dinner tarvatha night stay.
Day 9 — Sonprayag/Sitapur to Badrinath/Joshimath: Badrinath leda Joshimath ki travel chestham. Hotel check-in, dinner and night stay.
Day 10 — Badrinath and Mana Village: Badrinath Temple darshan chesi Tapt Kund, Mana Village lo sightseeing chestham. Night stay Chamoli leda Haridwar lo untundi.
Day 11 — Return to Delhi: Breakfast tarvatha Delhi ki return journey start chestham. Delhi drop tho trip complete avuthundi.
packages.notes: Trip notes: Kedarnath camping has common washrooms and no private rooms. AC is available only at the Haridwar hotel; other hotels are non-AC. Guests should carry their own water bottle. Early departures apply for Kedarnath and Yamunotri, with packed breakfast. The company may modify the itinerary due to conditions. Trekking distances, transport, hotel allocation, price, taxes, departure dates and availability must be reconfirmed before booking. The package details list package price ₹23,499 + 5% GST and a normal price ₹29,999; do not promise the offer is still active.
packages.doubleSharing: Double-sharing costs ₹3,000 extra per person for 8 nights. Kedarnath and Badrinath stays remain group-sharing.

packages.destination: Delhi, Manali, Kullu Valley, Solang Valley, Kasol, Manikaran Sahib

itinerary: Day 1 — Delhi to Manali: Assemble at the Delhi pickup point and board the overnight AC Volvo/coach to Manali. Scenic route may pass Bilaspur and Mandi. Overnight journey.

Day 2 — Manali local sightseeing: Arrive in Manali, check in and freshen up. Visit Hadimba Devi Temple, Old Manali, Van Vihar, Tibetan Monastery and Mall Road. Evening free for shopping and cafés. Overnight in Manali.

Day 5 — Delhi arrival: Arrive in Delhi in the morning. Trip concludes.

Day 2 — Shimla sightseeing: Breakfast. Visit Kufri, Green Valley, Jakhoo Temple, Christ Church, The Ridge, Mall Road and Scandal Point. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight stay in Shimla.

packages.name: Kerala 4 Nights / 5 Days
packages.destination: Kochi, Athirappally Waterfalls, Munnar, Thekkady, Periyar Lake, Alleppey, Marari Beach, Fort Kochi

itinerary: Day 1 — Kochi to Munnar: Pickup from Kochi Airport or Railway Station. Travel approximately 130 km / 4.5 hours towards Munnar. Visit Athirappally Waterfalls en route, then hotel check-in and leisure time among tea plantations. Dinner and overnight stay in Munnar.

Day 2 — Munnar sightseeing: After breakfast, visit Flower Garden, Echo Point, Mattupetty Dam, Lockhart Gap, Shooting Point and a spice garden. Return to hotel. Breakfast and dinner; overnight in Munnar.

Day 3 — Munnar to Thekkady: Travel approximately 90 km / 3 hours after breakfast. Visit Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary and Periyar Lake; boating and wildlife viewing are described in the itinerary. Day 4 — Thekkady to Alleppey: Travel approximately 140 km / 4 hours. Enjoy a Vembanad Lake backwater boat ride, paddy fields and lagoons, then visit Alleppey Beach for sunset. Breakfast and dinner; overnight in Alleppey.

Day 5 — Alleppey to Kochi: After breakfast, visit Marari Beach, Fort Kochi, Paradesi Jewish Synagogue and Chinese Fishing Nets. Drop at Kochi Airport or Railway Station for onward travel. Sightseeing may change due to traffic or natural conditions.
